author: Aevy TV
description:
YourStory’s TechSparks 2026 is bringing together *3,000+* founders, investors and policymakers in Bengaluru, where you’ll get to attend masterclasses, watch live tech demos, and hear conversations around some of the coolest ideas being built in Indian tech right now.

It’s happening from 13-15 October at *Taj, Teshwantpur*. So grab your tickets now!
title: This is your chance to meet the people building the future of tech in India! #ad
